native_new_county_politics: A solid county gatehouse with three converging cobbled paths at its base, a folded black ivory and cobalt cloth on the battlement. No flag, no coat of arms or symbolic device. Warm grey stone, cobalt cloth, black iron hinges.
native_the_idol: A half-open dark reliquary enclosing a veiled angular stone idol, the lid has simple architectural recessed panels without a coat of arms. Conceal the deity's body beneath dark cloth rather than inventing its anatomy. Obsidian stone, tarnished silver, restrained violet light contained inside the reliquary.
native_one_will: A tall black iron command staff with a plain violet faceted crystal at its top, three taut cords drawing smaller iron weights into rigid alignment. No runes, religious symbols or invented coat of arms. Obsidian black, cold silver and controlled deep violet.
